description: This file defines the SugarCacheFile class, a PHP class responsible for managing file-based caching within the SuiteCRM project. It extends an abstract cache class and handles reading from and writing to a cache file, including cache invalidation and access methods.

classes.name: SugarCacheFile
classes.description: A class providing file-based cache storage for SuiteCRM, managing cache file read/write operations, cache invalidation, and security measures against unserialization vulnerabilities.

methods.name: useBackend
methods.description: Determines whether to use the external cache backend based on configuration flags.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the cache handler, setting the cache file name based on global configuration.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Writes the cache data to disk if it has changed when the object is destroyed.

methods.name: __wakeup
methods.description: Prevents unserialization of the object for security reasons.

methods.name: _setExternal
methods.description: Marks the cache as changed when data is set (does not perform actual setting).

methods.name: _getExternal
methods.description: Loads cache data from the cache file and retrieves the requested key.

methods.name: _clearExternal
methods.description: Marks the cache as changed when data is cleared (does not perform actual clearing).

methods.name: _resetExternal
methods.description: Marks the cache as changed when cache is reset (does not perform actual reset).
